q1_issues.issue: The stated numeral "one" in "one vessel" is silently dropped, so the parse is indistinguishable from "yields a vessel" and widens the claim from exactly-one to at-least-one, which Core patterns bars (carry the qualifier or record the gap).

q2_gaps: a cardinal numeral on a SINGULAR count NP ("one vessel") — Cardinality is defined only as a count atom riding a group witness for a plural referred to as a unit, so a singleton has no licensed carrier
notes: The rest is right: indefinite "a thin day" with a verbal predicate correctly mints a witness rather than a generic rule, the inanimate transitive subject correctly keeps Agent, and no tense atom is the correct habitual default. Fusing "thin day" (rather than the two-atom incidental-description split) is a term-of-art judgment call, and it is self-consistent — genus "day" plus the gradable modifier genus "thin" are both emitted as the fusion route requires.
